title: 你和女生约会紧张的原因

timeline.summary: He says date anxiety comes from treating the woman as a judge whose reaction decides the man's personal worth.
He contrasts treating a failed date as one event to examine with treating it as proof that the whole self is a failure, and says multiple factors should be considered.
He says yes/no reactions should not determine worth and argues that lacking a stable internal position reduces perceived charm even when objective resources are high.
He uses people who made money in stocks or bitcoin yet remain insecure as examples for separating external value from a felt sense of value.

claims.speaker: Mikey
claims.statement: He says a man becomes tense on dates when he treats the woman's reaction as a verdict on his total personal worth.
claims.conditions: A broad explanatory model, not a diagnosis of every person's anxiety.

claims.speaker: Mikey

claims.conditions: Useful only as a reflective framing; the clip does not supply a complete assessment method.

claims.conditions: The financial examples are hypothetical/generalized and do not establish a mental-health causal rule.
